name: Table 2-33: Mark of the Curse
_doc: Roll for a Cursed Artefact to determine the nature of the curse.

rows.name: Bloodlust
rows.description: The wielder is overtaken by murderous fury at inappropriate moments.

rows.name: Mindkiller
rows.description: The artefact slowly erodes the user's intellect or memory.

rows.name: Alluring
rows.description: The artefact insinuates itself into its owner's affections, becoming psychologically inseparable.

rows.name: Entropic
rows.description: Mundane things near the artefact decay, fail, or break down at an accelerated rate.

rows.name: Deceitful
rows.description: The artefact misrepresents itself, hides its true nature, or twists the user's perceptions.
